text: わしが　これまでに　みた　いちばん　でかい　コイキング…　＊ｃｍ

structure.jp: わしが　これまでに　みた
structure.en: that I have seen up to now

structure.jp: いちばん　でかい　コイキング…

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: わしが　これまでに　みた　いちばん　でかい　コイキング
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed before a thing describes that thing, like 'that' in English. わしが　これまでに　みた　コイキング = 'the Magikarp that I have seen so far'.
